clips.title: The story
paras: Howling in the Hills is an Alliance bounty offered by Verner Osgood in Lakeshire to hunt down Yowler, the fearsome alpha leading the Redridge gnolls. With Stormwind's military stretched too thin fighting the Blackrock orcs to defend the local borders, Lakeshire relies on visiting adventurers to break the gnoll pack's command.

Even after culling the lesser gnolls raiding the paths around Lakeshire, their ominous calls continue to echo through the Redridge ridges. Verner Osgood, Lakeshire's hardworking farrier, recognizes that killing scouts and scavengers will never stem the tide as long as their pack leader remains alive. Rising above the rabble is Yowler, an exceptionally cunning and massive gnoll whose calls direct the pack across the hills. Verner tasks adventurers with hunting down the beast and severing his paw to ensure the howling is silenced once and for all.

This contract highlights the grim reality facing the eastern borders of the kingdom of Stormwind. With the missing King Varian Wrynn and regency disputes paralyzing high command, royal soldiers are focused almost exclusively on the entrenched Blackrock orc clans in the north. Everyday settlements like Lakeshire are left completely undefended against native menaces like gnolls, forcing townsfolk like Verner Osgood to organize their own bounties to prevent their homes from being overrun.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Friend, the gnolls are still out there. I can hear their baying as they hunt in the hills above Lakeshire. And one cry is louder than the rest - Yowler, their leader.
Kill Yowler and send his pack scattering! Bring me his paw as proof.
And be careful, this gnoll is their leader for a reason. He is no Mongrel...

clips.title: Progress
paras: Yowler is a dangerous creature, friend. If you're not ready for him, I understand.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Again, thank you for your help. The Stormwind army is so busy dealing with the orcs, they don't have the troops to protect Redridge from local threats like the gnolls.
